UNIT TRIP ACTIONS (bmsTrip, latched, first-out recorded):
• XV-101 benzene and XV-105 make-up H2 close (de-energise).
• FIC-101, FIC-103, PIC-105 to MAN, output 0 %: FV-101, FV-103,
PV-105 close behind the SIS valves.
• HS-101 → COOL: HY-101A/B open, HY-101C/D shut (MP steam off);
• HS-102 → COOL: HY-102B/C open, HY-102A/D shut; TV-102 100 %.
• ESD (HS-100) only: EDV-101 opens to flare.
• Recommended (SL-R7, HOLD): stop P-100A/B on unit trip.
• Blocked while a process trip condition is active or TI-100 > 210 °C.
• After reset H2 and benzene stay isolated until admitted again.
• XV-105 (H2) may open only with loop O2 AI-100 < 1 %.
• XV-101 (benzene) may open only with ALL of:
SIS reset, no trip latched · XV-105 open and AI-105 ≥ 80 % ·
LIC-101 ≥ 40 % · M-101 running · K-101 running and
FAIL POSITIONS ON INSTRUMENT AIR FAILURE (step() FAIL map):
• FO: FV-104 (full flow through E-101), LV-109 (BFW), PV-110 (LP steam).
• SIS valves XV-101, XV-105, XV-104*, EIV-1nn* FC; EDV-101 FO (assumed).
• HY valves: fail to the COOL line-up (HY-101A/B, HY-102B/C FO).
1 DESIGN CASE (OTS model at design): R-102 160 °C / 29.60 bar g, level 55 %, jacket on MP steam 2.33 t/h (HS-102 HEAT); liquid to R-103
20.9 t/h, F-102 ΔP 0.26 bar (alarm 0.8); R-103 bed 158.5-158.6 °C; V-104 29.0 bar g / 44.9 °C, level 50 %; product 37.5 t/h, benzene 2.0
ppm, MCP 60 ppm; recycle 46,000 Nm³/h at 92.1 % H2; make-up 31,974 Nm³/h; purge 2,017 Nm³/h (HIC-107 25 %); K-101 discharge 32.0 bar g.
2 Loop pressure profile (model): K-101 32.0 → R-101 30.0 → R-102 29.6 → R-103 29.25 → V-104 29.0 bar g. K-101 discharge 57 °C by isentropic
compression (η 0.70 assumed) vs 60 °C in the model.
3 PSV-102*, PSV-104* set 36 bar g = loop design pressure (assumed); PSV-112* set 42 bar g (K-101 deadhead 35 × 1.154 = 40.4 bar g);
TSV-102J*, TSV-106* 10 bar g; TSV-102F* 36 bar g. Relief loads and flare header size: HOLD. V-190* flare knock-out drum is off this

6 F-102A in service (inlet / outlet MVs open), F-102B on stand-by (shut, drained). Change-over: open B outlet, then B inlet, shut A inlet,
then A outlet; A is drained under N2 and kept wet (spent Raney-Ni is pyrophoric, CAT-2).
